capabilities: search Google Maps for places with live autocomplete results
insert picked place's coordinates into note frontmatter
optionally write the formatted address to frontmatter
store the Google Maps API key in Obsidian's secret storage
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; must be installed manually by copying built files into the vault's plugins folder.
problem: Map plugins need coordinates in each note's frontmatter, which normally requires leaving Obsidian and copy-pasting lat/lng from Google Maps by hand.

relations.evidence: Map plugins like Obsidian Leaflet and Map View can render those notes on a map
matches the convention used by Obsidian Leaflet and Map View

requires.name: Google Maps API key (Places API New)
Google Places API billing (monthly free tier)

summary: Google Maps place-search command that writes a place's coordinates and address into the current note's frontmatter.
